title: SG-1.3 generateArt CLI targets the manifest and assets the app consumes
summary: Point the generateArt CLI at the real manifest and assets folder, resolved from the script location
description: Context: game/frontend/scripts/generateArt.ts runs the generator with manifestPath 'public/assets/manifest.json' and assetsRoot 'public/assets', resolved against the current directory. The app imports game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json in src/runtime/content.ts, so the CLI never touches that file. Desired behavior: the CLI reads and rewrites the existing manifest and writes PNGs under game/public/assets, wherever it is started from. Why: the Done-when for SG-1.3 requires the script to update the manifest the app consumes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the CLI is started from any directory, when it resolves its defaults, then manifestPath ends with game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json and assetsRoot ends with game/public/assets
Given a mocked fs with the existing manifest, when the CLI I/O runs, then that manifest is read and rewritten and no other manifest file is created
Given the existing generateArt tests, when they run, then identical bytes and npm script behaviour still pass

in_scope: Unit test with mocked I/O asserting the default paths
out_of_scope: Changes to generateAssets, mergeManifest or encodePng

technical_constraints: Hard constraint: all art generated deterministically in-repo, no downloads or CDN
Hard constraint: tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked
Paths come from the script location (import.meta.url), not process.cwd()
definition_of_done: CLI default paths point at the-boys-room manifest and public/assets
Unit test asserts the default paths with I/O mocked
